reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: Appointment of Mr. R. J. A. M. S. Arshan as Acting Chief Executive Officer with effect from 26th September 2026
reqBaseAnnouncement.newCeoName: Mr. R. J. A. M. S. Arshan
reqBaseAnnouncement.profile:
Mr. Arshan is a projects, business consulting, operations, sales and marketing professional with over 25 years of experience across government projects and private-sector industrial businesses. 

He most recently served as a Projects Consultant to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority and has held senior positions including Director – Logistics and Operations at Massline International (Pvt) Ltd, Senior Manager – Sales, Marketing and Projects at Magline Switchboards (Pvt) Ltd, and Senior Manager – Industrial Projects and Corporate at OREL Corporation. 

His qualifications include a B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Moratuwa; a B.Sc. (Honours)/Higher Education qualification from the University of Portsmouth/SQA, UK; a Diploma in Business Higher Management; higher education studies in Business Management; a Higher National Diploma in Computing from SYSCOMES, UAE/SQA, UK; a Diploma in Computing with Second Class Honours (Lower Division) from SYSCOMES, UAE; an Advanced Diploma in Information Technology; a Diploma in Business Management from the British Council, Colombo; a Diploma in English; and a Junior Diploma in Information Technology from SYSCOMES, UAE.

He is also a member of the Federation of Information Technology Industry Sri Lanka and the Sri Lanka Computer Vendor Association. Mr. Arshan possesses extensive expertise in project consulting, industrial project management, business development, corporate account management, logistics, operations, tender management, commercial negotiation and stakeholder coordination. His broad project, operational and commercial experience will strengthen the Board’s strategic planning, business-development and project-oversight capabilities.
